label: miso 111b prb dispatch
definition: (PROBE, REJECTED on pre-registered guards G1+G2) miso-111 arm B: keeper recipe + coal_prb_committed_dispatchable=true — PRB committed bands excluded from the regulated take-or-pay discount, bidding full delivered cost (measured conduct: regulated PRB cycles within-run, price-responsively; PREREG-miso111 §8). Single delta vs miso111_control_A at the same HEAD. RESULT: C7 COAL_PRB cv_ratio 0.466->0.828 (2023, PASS) / 0.475->1.028 (2024, PASS) / 0.314->0.411 (2025, still FAIL vs 0.5 gate) with profile_r 0.97-0.99 and COAL_BIT untouched — but C1 COAL_PRB flips out of band in the cheap-gas years (-8.77 TWh 2023, -14.97 TWh 2024 vs a ±8 TWh tolerance; energy displaced to CC_REGULAR/imports/CT_PEAKER, which all stay in band). The G2 kill fires: the committed-band discount is carrying ~9-15 TWh/yr of REAL stay-online self-commitment energy that the mustrun band alone does not carry — repricing the whole band deletes it (the miso-102 objection reproduced at PRB scale, now precisely sized). Named successor: split the committed band on the measured within-run loading distribution (reality's night level 0.62 HSL sits BETWEEN mustrun 0.46 and full 0.92) — a hold-through slice keeping the contract discount + a cycling slice at SRMC, both sizes from the same CAMPD construction.
